_comment: Brown & Brown Insurance – Hit Ratio Snapshot Flow (Power Automate)
_description: Runs on the 1st of each month. Aggregates bound/lost/expired quotes from the prior month and writes hit-ratio snapshot records to bnb_hitratio, broken down by segment, producer, and carrier.
name: BnB_HitRatio_Monthly_Snapshot

parameters.$filter: bnb_submission_date ge @{outputs('Compose_Period')?['periodStart']} and bnb_submission_date le @{outputs('Compose_Period')?['periodEnd']} and (bnb_quote_status eq 200000004 or bnb_quote_status eq 200000005 or bnb_quote_status eq 200000006)

FetchAll_Segments_Aggregate._comment: In production, use a custom connector or Dataverse FetchXML aggregate query. This stub shows the pattern.

inputs.fetchXML_example: <fetch aggregate='true'><entity name='bnb_inflightquote'><attribute name='bnb_business_segment' groupby='true' alias='segment'/><attribute name='bnb_quote_status' aggregate='count' alias='total'/><filter><condition attribute='bnb_submission_date' operator='ge' value='@{outputs(''Compose_Period'')?[''periodStart'']}'/>  <condition attribute='bnb_submission_date' operator='le' value='@{outputs(''Compose_Period'')?[''periodEnd'']}'/>  </filter></entity></fetch>
